items.summary: NVIDIA has introduced Kumo Forecast, a multi-variate time-series model combining pretrained representations with historical pattern retrieval. Built on the MOMENT-1-large backbone, it offers an Apache 2.0 license and includes an interpretability framework. The system supports various input lengths and integrates with the Factory Operations Blueprint for predictive maintenance.
items.title: NVIDIA Unveils Kumo Forecast Model with Interpretability Features

items.summary: Michael Gerstenhaber, VP of Product Management at Google Cloud, announced the expansion of its model garden to include OpenAI models. This move positions Google Cloud as the only hyperscale provider offering access to all three leading closed-source LLMs alongside over 200 other models. The new OpenAI models are currently rolling out in private preview to select enterprise customers, allowing teams to select optimal models based on performance and cost without architectural lock-in.
items.title: Google Cloud Adds OpenAI Models to Enterprise Platform

items.summary: NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity to support AI model training and inference. Partners like Nscale, Crusoe, and Nebius are deploying NVIDIA infrastructure, including Vera Rubin and DSX platforms, to enhance power efficiency and throughput. The ecosystem emphasizes sovereign computing, open models, and secure boundaries for AI agents. Companies such as Mistral and Nebius are integrating these technologies to build specialized applications, while initiatives like the NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture aim to provide organizations with full-stack control over AI agent deployments.
items.title: NVIDIA Cloud Partners Expand European AI Infrastructure with Sovereign, Open, and Safe Solutions

items.summary: Europe's industrial leaders are adopting NVIDIA technologies, including CUDA-X, Omniverse, and Cosmos models, to enhance productivity and innovation across engineering and manufacturing. NVIDIA has released the Factory Operations Blueprint (FOX) to help developers build agents for factory management and inspection. Siemens is integrating these agents into its enterprise system, estimating 20% cost savings and reducing calibration time by 40%. Other companies, such as Mercedes-Benz, Cadence, and Autodesk, are using NVIDIA tools for faster simulations and design iterations. imec and Infineon report significant speedups in semiconductor simulations using NVIDIA accelerated computing. These initiatives aim to optimize operations, reduce physical testing, and improve design efficiency through AI and digital twins.
items.title: European Industrial Leaders Adopt NVIDIA Tools for Engineering and Manufacturing

items.summary: NVIDIA DSX POD is a reference design intended to help operators achieve productive AI capacity faster and more predictably. By shifting much of the integration and validation work from the customer site to a controlled factory environment, the design reduces onsite complexity and schedule exposure. The architecture supports the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, treating compute, networking, storage, power, and cooling as a coordinated system. While it does not eliminate onsite work, it moves complex, repeatable tasks into a manufacturing setting to simplify deployment and ensure quality.
items.title: NVIDIA DSX POD Aims to Accelerate AI Factory Deployment

items.summary: At Nvidia's GTC conference in Berlin, Jensen Huang presented a vision for Europe centered on robotics, AI agents, and modular data centers. He introduced the DSX Pod, a containerized solution that can be operational in 14 days. Huang emphasized a shift from consuming to producing AI, highlighting partnerships with European carmakers and plans for a new robotics platform.
items.title: Jensen Huang Unveils Nvidia's AI Vision for Europe

items.summary: Amazon's Blink line announced five new home surveillance cameras, including a 4K wired model and extended-range options. The Frontier XR+ reaches up to 7,000 feet, while the Outdoor 2K XR+ covers 2,700 feet. Prices range from $50 to $200, with preorders starting October 21st. These upgrades aim to support very large outdoor properties.
items.title: Amazon Blink Unveils Five New Home Security Cameras

items.summary: Microsoft released PowerToys version 0.102, introducing Mouse Button Lock and CursorHide utilities. Senior product manager Niels Laute explained that Mouse Button Lock allows users to drag or select items by holding a key while a mouse button is treated as held. The update also includes improvements to the Command Palette and new command-line tools. PowerToys, originally a collection of freeware tools, was revived by Microsoft in 2019 as an open-source utility pack.
items.title: Microsoft Releases PowerToys 0.102 with New Mouse Tools

items.summary: IBM announced three updates to its Granite Speech collection, introducing granite-speech-5.0-2b for high-accuracy transcription and translation, a revised granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc for faster edge processing, and an updated granite-speech-4.1-2b-plus optimized for multi-speaker meetings. The models support multiple languages and offer features like keyword biasing and improved speaker attribution, released under an Apache 2.0 license.
items.title: IBM Unveils Granite Speech 5.0 with Enhanced Accuracy and Speed

items.summary: National Development Minister Chee Hong Tat warned that listed companies involved in illegal haze-causing activities may face legal and financial penalties. Speaking at the SIAS Investors' Choice Awards on Oct 21, he emphasized that such consequences affect shareholders. MAS will support investor education through new IPO guides to help investors identify relevant risks before investing.
items.title: Singapore Officials Warn Companies of Haze-Related Financial Risks

items.summary: CEOs of Keppel, SGX, and Thakral won the Investors' Choice Outstanding CEO Award from the Securities Investors Association (Singapore) on Oct 21. They were recognized for excellence in corporate governance, sustainability, transparency, and shareholder communications. Keppel's Loh Chin Hua highlighted the importance of clear communication during the company's transformation. SGX's Loh Boon Chye emphasized growing the local investing ecosystem and unlocking value. Thakral's Inderbethal Singh Thakral discussed staying positive in crises and finding opportunities. All three leaders shared insights on increasing shareholder value and the essential traits of a good CEO.
items.title: CEOs of Keppel, SGX, and Thakral Win Outstanding CEO Awards

items.summary: NVIDIA and the University of Washington introduced RFD4-Proteina, a model using reward-guided inference-time search to design proteins. It combines fast generation with smart search to focus compute on promising candidates for drug discovery tasks like targeting PD-L1.
items.title: NVIDIA and UW Develop RFD4-Proteina for Protein Design

items.summary: IBM researchers have developed vLLM-Hook MIA, a plugin library designed to enable fast runtime monitoring and control of large language models without significantly slowing down performance. The tool targets the vLLM inference engine, allowing developers to observe and steer model states to improve safety and accuracy. In experiments, the plugin was up to 20 times faster than its predecessor and introduced minimal delays, such as 2% for smaller models and 6% for a 70B model. This advancement aims to make last-minute safety checks more practical for production environments.
items.title: IBM Unveils vLLM-Hook MIA for Fast AI Monitoring

items.summary: Ong Wei Yuan argues that while artificial intelligence can aid in structuring ideas and managing routine tasks, it should serve as an assistant rather than a substitute for human judgment. The author warns that over-reliance on AI may result in polished yet hollow communication, where nuances are lost and accountability is diluted. Consequently, organizations should encourage staff to use AI tools only to support, not replace, the critical thinking and responsibility required in professional exchanges.
items.title: Forum: AI should be an assistant in professional communication, not a substitute for judgment

items.summary: A resident wrote to the Housing Board and relevant authorities regarding fire hazards caused by residents storing personal items and mobility devices in common corridors and stairwells. The writer noted that current advisory notes are ineffective without decisive enforcement. They urged the authorities to consider a total ban on placing personal belongings outside units, accompanied by clear penalties and prompt removal of illegal items to ensure safe evacuation routes.
items.title: Resident Urges Strict Enforcement on Corridor Storage Bans

items.summary: NVIDIA and Databricks are integrating the RFD4-Proteina model into Databricks' Genesis Workbench to streamline protein design workflows. This collaboration allows life sciences teams to run models on their own governed data without transferring sensitive intellectual property. The integration connects model execution with research data, reducing infrastructure overhead. Mike Sanky of Databricks noted that drug discovery is fundamentally a data problem, while Anthony Costa of NVIDIA emphasized that the challenge lies in selecting the most promising candidates for laboratory testing. The platform offers prebuilt workflows for antibody and vaccine design, supported by AI-assisted development and serverless GPU compute.
items.title: NVIDIA and Databricks Integrate RFD4-Proteina for Protein Design

items.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, founder of Techable Ventures and former Nvidia employee, told TechCrunch's Equity that the robotics industry is experiencing a 'ChatGPT moment.' She described the current state as a 'LEGO era,' where foundational software and building blocks like robotic hands are being developed to eventually scale innovation. Vishwanath noted that talent remains a critical factor, with many experts moving to large companies like Anthropic and Nvidia.
items.title: Amulya Vishwanath Compares Physical AI Development to LEGO Era

items.summary: OpenEvidence, an AI-powered search engine for medical decisions, reached a $15 billion valuation after nearly two-thirds of US doctors adopted it. Founded by Daniel Nadler in 2022, the Miami-based startup processed over 42 million physician prompts last month. While praised for easing workloads, the company faces scrutiny over result accuracy and competition from major AI firms like OpenAI.
items.title: OpenEvidence Valued at $15 Billion as Doctors Adopt AI Search Tool

items.summary: Websites across Europe, including those of the Finnish government, Edinburgh council, and the BBC, were taken down ahead of a critical software update for the PHP programming language. Cyber-security firms Calif and Wiz discovered two severe vulnerabilities using AI, describing them as the most severe ever found. While the firms estimated roughly 70% of the internet is affected, the BBC could not verify this figure. Authorities urged organizations to apply fixes or take systems offline, noting that PHP powers a large portion of the web and may have gone undetected for over a decade. Early attacks are already emerging, prompting global agencies to issue warnings and mitigation strategies.
items.title: European Governments and Organizations Take Down Websites Over Critical PHP Vulnerabilities

items.summary: The Prix Pascal de Littérature IA has launched, inviting submissions of manuscripts co-written with AI tools. Entrants must submit unpublished French texts between 10,000 and 50,000 words detailing the specific AI models and prompts used. Founded by technology entrepreneurs, the prize responds to recent controversies regarding AI in literature. Winners will receive publication, with a shortlist of ten announced before the early December winner reveal.
items.title: New French Prize Launches for AI-Coauthored Books Amid Controversy

items.summary: Japan recorded a trade deficit of $17.8 billion from April to September, nearly double the previous year's figure, according to government data. The surge in costs stems from the Middle East crisis, which disrupted oil and LNG supplies through the Strait of Hormuz, driving up import prices despite reduced volumes. Japan is diversifying energy sources and releasing strategic reserves to mitigate the impact.
items.title: Japan's Trade Deficit Doubles Amid Rising Energy Import Costs

items.summary: Hungarian company MOL denied signing a purchase agreement for Naftna Industrija Srbije (NIS), contradicting earlier claims by Serbia's Acting Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance, Siniša Mali. While Mali stated a contract was signed and a shareholders' agreement exists, MOL reported no changes requiring capital market notification. The transaction awaits antimonopoly commission approval before closing.
items.title: MOL Denies Signing NIS Purchase Deal Amidst Serbian Claims

items.summary: ADEX Group launched a common intraday continuous market environment integrating the Slovenian, Hungarian, and Serbian electricity markets. The Slovenian BSP now manages operational activities, replacing separate administrative entities. This centralization aims to strengthen cooperation, improve liquidity, and enhance price transparency across Central and South-Eastern Europe, potentially benefiting grid stability and market coupling with the EU.
items.title: ADEX Group Launches Unified Intraday Market Platform Across Three Countries

items.summary: SBI Research indicates the Reserve Bank of India may tighten monetary policy in December via a 50-basis-point repo rate hike or a 25-basis-point hike paired with an asymmetric LAF corridor adjustment. The report, dated October 21, forecasts a cumulative 50 bps increase due to broadening inflationary pressures, elevated crude oil prices, and global economic uncertainty. The RBI has not yet announced a specific decision.
items.title: SBI Research Outlines RBI Policy Options for December Meeting

items.summary: Anthropic, the parent company of Claude AI, reported a net loss of 80.7 billion dollars in the first half of 2026. Reuters notes that most of this loss stems from non-cash accounting charges related to convertible bonds, rather than actual cash expenditure. The company is preparing for a potential IPO in November.
items.title: Anthropic Reports Massive Loss Ahead of Potential IPO

items.summary: Apple stated on Wednesday that it will offer limited numbers of the folding iPhone Duo for walk-in customers upon its Friday launch. This follows initial online orders selling out in minutes, which extended delivery times for some customers to January.
items.title: Apple Announces Limited iPhone Duo Availability for Friday Launch

items.summary: OpenAI announced on October 21 that it is expanding advertising on ChatGPT to 26 additional countries, bringing the total to 89. The company aims to boost revenue ahead of a potential initial public offering. Ads will appear only on Free and Go plans, while subscriptions remain ad-free. Over 100,000 advertisers have already run campaigns on the platform.
items.title: OpenAI Expands ChatGPT Ads to 89 Countries to Boost Revenue

items.summary: Elon Musk's companies, SpaceX and Tesla, are exploring a merger that would create a $3.5 trillion corporate giant. Musk argues combining them would deepen cooperation on technologies like chip design and robotics. Share prices rose following the announcement. The deal would bring together Musk's tech and infrastructure sectors, though concerns remain about shareholder control and Musk's influence over both entities.
items.title: SpaceX and Tesla Explore $3.5 Trillion Merger Under Discussion

items.summary: SpaceX reported a 161% revenue increase in the third quarter, driving its stock up 8%. CEO Elon Musk revealed that special committees at SpaceX and Tesla are considering a potential merger, which would create the largest transaction on record. Tesla shares also rose more than 3% amid the news and broader market gains.
items.title: SpaceX Stock Jumps on Revenue Growth and Tesla Merger Rumors

items.summary: Ferrari CEO Benedetto Vigna rated Tesla's Roadster launch 10 out of 10 for technology and presentation, citing it as proof of automotive innovation. Speaking at a conference, Vigna emphasized the need for dreaming and external input for Ferrari's electric Luce model. Meanwhile, Tesla's Roadster demonstrated a 0 to 60 mph time under one second, while Ferrari's Luce faced stock drops and pricing challenges.
items.title: Ferrari CEO praises Tesla Roadster launch while addressing Luce skepticism

items.summary: President John Dramani Mahama announced that Ghana intends to ban the export of raw mineral ores by 2030. This move aims to increase domestic processing capabilities. Mahama stated that investors must understand the processing obligations tied to accessing these resources. The initiative aligns with broader efforts by African nations to capture more value from their mineral supplies.
items.title: Ghana Plans 2030 Mineral Export Ban to Boost Domestic Processing

items.summary: Bernd Lange, chair of the European Parliament's Trade Committee, urges the EU to pursue a comprehensive trade agreement with China rather than negotiating sector by sector. Speaking ahead of an upcoming visit to Beijing, Lange argues that a broader pact is necessary to address unfair trade practices and revive elements of the frozen investment agreement. He highlights the need to tackle issues such as export restrictions and subsidies affecting multiple industries.
items.title: EU Trade Chief Calls for Revival of Broader China Deal Ahead of Beijing Visit

items.summary: China launched the Xiguang-4 01 satellite into a 541 km-altitude low Earth orbit to serve as the pilot for the Wuyang Constellation, the world's first low-inclination remote sensing constellation. Developed by Galactic Energy, the CERES-1S rocket delivered the satellite to provide commercial services for the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and other low-latitude regions, supporting tasks like natural resource monitoring and disaster response.
items.title: China launches Xiguang-4 01 satellite for remote sensing net

items.summary: An environmental official stated that China will accelerate its green transition and fulfill its 2030 climate goals during the 15th Five-Year Plan. Li Gao, vice minister of ecology and environment, noted that installed renewable energy capacity reached 2. 455 billion kilowatts in the first half of the year, accounting for 60. 7% of total capacity. Solar power surpassed coal as the largest source by late July. China also leads globally in nuclear capacity and new energy vehicle production. The country has strengthened its climate legislation and carbon market, with trading volume surpassing 1 billion tonnes.
items.title: China Accelerates Green Transition and Climate Action

items.summary: The article explains that ginseng is a renowned herb in traditional Chinese medicine used to replenish vital energy and restore strength. It describes the plant's human-like root shape and notes its application for conditions like weakness and insomnia. The text advises consulting healthcare professionals before use and cites the Pharmacopoeia of the People's Republic of China as a source.
items.title: Article Explains Ginseng Uses and Origins in Traditional Chinese Medicine

items.summary: Poland's Sejm voted on October 20 to amend the Criminal Code, easing penalties for those assisting abortions and restoring access for severe foetal abnormalities. While this marks a tentative step toward Prime Minister Donald Tusk's coalition pledge, the changes fall short of allowing abortion on request. The legislation faces a likely presidential veto from President Karol Nawrocki, who opposes easing restrictions. Even if passed, Poland would remain one of only two EU countries where early pregnancy abortion is illegal. Critics argue the narrow scope leaves most women unable to access care locally.
items.title: Poland Votes to Ease Abortion Rules Despite EU Restrictions

items.summary: EU prosecutors searched offices of the far-right Patriots for Europe bloc in Brussels and Strasbourg as part of an investigation into its predecessor, Identity and Democracy. The probe alleges misappropriation of €4.3 million between 2019 and 2024. The Patriots group denies involvement, stating no legal continuity exists with the dissolved group. The European Public Prosecutor's Office confirmed the searches but withheld further details to protect the proceedings.
items.title: Prosecutors Search Far-Right Patriots Bloc Offices in Graft Probe

items.summary: EU regulators have launched an investigation into Booking.com, alleging the platform failed to adequately protect consumers from fake listings and scams under the Digital Services Act. Officials cite a 'substandard' approach to fraud prevention. The inquiry follows reports of scams involving high-profile addresses and data misuse, with consumer groups noting significant financial losses. Booking.com states it is engaging constructively with authorities.
items.title: EU regulators investigate Booking.com over fake listings and scams

items.summary: UN officials warn that the humanitarian system cannot cope alone with the impending powerful El Nino event. World Meteorological Organization Secretary-General Celeste Saulo and UN aid chief Tom Fletcher urge global mobilization, noting the window for preparedness is still open. They forecast sea surface temperatures could rise significantly, exposing millions to hunger. The UN has released $50 million to support 11 countries in preparation.
items.title: UN Warns Humanitarian System Cannot Cope Alone With Powerful El Nino

items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky proposed freezing the front lines with Russia as a preliminary step toward peace negotiations. Speaking on Fox and Friends, he emphasized that any agreement must include Ukraine and security guarantees from allies to prevent future aggression. His comments coincided with US envoy Steve Witkoff meeting Russian President Vladimir Putin in Saint Petersburg to discuss ending the war.
items.title: Zelensky Proposes Frontline Freeze as Initial Peace Step

items.summary: Andy Burnham has supported mandatory suicide prevention training for social workers following the death of Matilda Davis, a parent-carer who took her life minutes after meeting professionals. The Guardian revealed Davis felt exhausted and failed by the social care system. Burnham, responding to Liberal Democrat MP Manuela Perteghella, agreed to ensure a minister meets the family to discuss the proposal. A coroner previously ordered Warwickshire council to make such training mandatory for 600 staff after social workers admitted they did not ask Davis about suicidal thoughts despite her distress. Davis's brother stated the training would have saved her life and criticized the current system for creating a postcode lottery.
items.title: Burnham backs mandatory suicide training for social workers after parent-carer death

items.summary: The UN migration agency warns that nearly 874,000 people in Somalia could be displaced by floods over the next three months. Projections developed with the Danish Refugee Council estimate 874,319 people at risk between October and December, with flooding accounting for 92% of the total. IOM says only 14.4% of the $16.62 million needed for preparedness has been secured.
items.title: UN warns of massive displacement risk in Somalia due to floods

items.summary: A daily news compilation dated October 21, 2026, reports on diverse international events. These include business moves by Nigeria's Dangote group, diplomatic meetings between Russia and the US, sports suspensions by FIFA, legal changes in Burkina Faso, UN condemnations in Sudan, and political speculation regarding Senegal's Macky Sall.
items.title: Global News Roundup Covers Business, Politics, and Sports Headlines

items.summary: The Indian rupee rose to 94.45 against the dollar, supported by US diplomatic engagement and RBI measures to regulate dollar purchases. However, elevated crude oil prices near $105 to $110 per barrel act as a headwind. Analysts note the currency faces resistance in the 94.25–94.40 zone due to external pressures and persistent foreign portfolio outflows.
items.title: Rupee gains on India-US trade hopes but faces oil headwinds

items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's ₹50,000 crore overnight Variable Rate Repo auction attracted nearly twice the notified amount, receiving bids worth ₹93,241 crore. Accepted bids totaled ₹50,007 crore at a 5.52% rate. Systemic liquidity remains in surplus of ₹48,303.95 crore as of October 20. Recent measures, including a CRR increase to 99%, aim to drain surplus liquidity and facilitate rate transmission.
items.title: RBI VRR Auction Attracts Double Bids Amid Liquidity Drain Measures

items.summary: A report indicates Microsoft plans to launch a next-generation Xbox handheld in 2027 and a console in 2028, codenamed Project Helix. The console is expected to cost between $1,200 and $1,800. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma described the hardware as a 'family of devices.' The report notes internal disagreements between Windows and Xbox teams regarding software control.
items.title: Microsoft Plans Xbox Handheld and Next-Gen Console Launches

items.summary: Police in Talegaon Dabhade, Pune, report that a 16-year-old boy was seriously injured with a koyta by three minors on Tuesday evening. The attack allegedly stemmed from the victim's WhatsApp status reading 'King Is Back,' posted after youths released from a juvenile observation home. Police detained the suspects and registered a case under the BNS and Arms Act while the investigation continues.
items.title: Teenager Attacked With Koyta Over WhatsApp Status in Pune

items.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened sharply against the US dollar on Wednesday, closing at 94.43 after gaining 48 paise. Foreign currency inflows from the Jio Platforms IPO and support from the Reserve Bank of India drove the recovery to a six-week high. However, rising crude oil prices and weak equity markets limited further gains. Analysts expect the pair to trade between 94.20 and 94.80.
items.title: Rupee Surges on Jio IPO Inflows and RBI Support

items.summary: OpenAI will provide approved learning resources from its OpenAI Academy via the iGOT Karmayogi platform under Mission Karmayogi. The initiative targets eligible personnel across central, state, and union territory governments. The platform currently hosts over 1.7 crore registered government employees. OpenAI is partnering with Karmayogi Bharat to introduce these AI learning courses.
items.title: OpenAI Partners With Karmayogi Bharat for Government AI Training

items.summary: Elon Musk stated he would support a merger between SpaceX and Tesla, describing the combination as a good idea while noting the process is complex. Independent committees at both companies are studying the proposal, though no deal is guaranteed. SpaceX reported its first quarterly profit driven by AI computing deals, with revenue jumping 161% to $14.6 billion.
items.title: Musk Supports SpaceX-Tesla Merger Amid AI Profit Surge

items.summary: The All India Kisan Sabha warned the Indian government of 'militant resistance' if it proceeds with a proposed India-US trade deal. The organization claims concessions to Washington would threaten agriculture and lead to corporate consolidation, stating that Indian farmers cannot compete with heavily subsidised American producers. The group also criticized the government for keeping Parliament in the dark about the negotiations.
items.title: All India Kisan Sabha Threatens Militant Resistance Over India-US Trade Deal

items.summary: China's new export controls on tunnel boring machines threaten India's infrastructure projects, but Germany's established manufacturing presence offers an alternative. Nearly half of India's TBMs are German-made, with Herrenknecht holding a 40-45% market share. Local facilities and indigenous development efforts aim to reduce reliance on Chinese equipment and supply-chain disruptions.
items.title: Germany's Manufacturing Presence Mitigates India's TBM Supply Risks Amid China Export Curbs

items.summary: Despite the Sensex falling 143 points, five BSE 1000 stocks hit 52-week highs. PC Jeweller, Sky Gold and Diamonds, HFCL, The South Indian Bank, and Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem gained between 7% and 45% in the last month.
items.title: Five BSE stocks hit 52-week highs despite Sensex fall

items.summary: The State Bank of India is investigating the exposure of approximately 375,000 records on the dark web, of which 3,897 contained personally identifiable information. Alerts regarding this suspected exposure were received on 16 October from the Defence Cyber Agency and CERT-In. While SBI stated the incident would not materially impact its core systems or financial performance, cybersecurity experts warn that the leaked data could facilitate targeted fraud and social-engineering attacks. The bank has activated containment protocols and appointed an independent agency to assess the breach's extent. This incident marks the second major cybersecurity attack involving a public sector bank in recent months.
items.title: SBI Investigates Customer Data Leak on Dark Web Amid Fraud Warnings

items.summary: Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the Cockroach Janta Party, posted on X praising leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka following their release by a Special Executive Magistrate. Dipke stated he was happy to follow their orders. The Delhi High Court ordered the release after questioning the duo's ages, noting they were not Gen Z. Das is 27 and Ranka is 32. They were detained for protesting at Jantar Mantar.
items.title: CJP Leader Dipke Praises Released Leaders After Court Order

items.summary: Haryana power staff are set to strike for three days to protest the Haryana Electricity Regulatory Commission's decision to grant a 25-year parallel power distribution licence to Eleven Power Private Limited for Gurugram and Nuh. The unions argue this move threatens the state-run Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam and represents privatisation. Despite appeals from Power and Energy Minister Anil Vij and Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini to call off the agitation, the employees remain firm. The government has assured it will challenge the order before the Appellate Tribunal for Electricity. Opposition Congress leaders have also criticised the decision, accusing the government of contradictory signals regarding privatisation.
items.title: Haryana Power Staff Strike Over Private Licence Despite Government Appeal

items.summary: The Indian Centre has issued an advisory to television channels, directing them to exercise stricter editorial control over debates and panel discussions to prevent the airing of communal, anti-national, or inflammatory content. The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting instructed broadcasters to carefully select panellists, mute abusive speakers, and cut feeds where necessary. Channels were also cautioned against live coverage of anti-terror operations and urged to use verified facts, approved maps, and AI tools responsibly. The directive follows observations by the Inter-Departmental Committee regarding non-compliance with the Programme Code by private satellite television channels.
items.title: Centre directs TV channels to curb abusive debates and verify content

items.summary: A Sacramento jury ordered the city to pay $33.3 million to Michael Flynn, a former physics student who suffered a brain injury after a 30-foot dead tree branch struck him in McKinley Park in 2020. The jury found the city 100 per cent responsible for failing to maintain public trees and ignored safety inspections. Flynn, who earned a doctorate despite the injury, urged greater accountability for public infrastructure.
items.title: Sacramento Jury Awards $33.3 Million for Park Tree Injury

items.summary: A Los Angeles property in Toluca Lake changed hands from actress Kirsten Dunst to Annie Potts. Dunst bought the residence in 2001 for $2.6 million and sold it in 2019 for $4.55 million. Potts, who previously sold two other homes, purchased the five-bedroom home just nine days after it hit the market. Reports highlight the property's appeal to entertainment-industry figures due to its waterfront setting and classic interiors.
items.title: Actresses Buy and Sell Hollywood Home in Toluca Lake

items.summary: India's highest-altitude High Court bench in Leh commenced regular hearings on October 21 at an elevation of over 11,500 feet. Chief Justice Pushpendra Singh Bhati and Justice Sanjay Parihar presided over the first session, utilizing a hybrid model with virtual and physical participation. The Ladakh Bench, inaugurated by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant on October 18, aims to improve judicial access for remote regions, eliminating the need for litigants to travel to Srinagar or Jammu.
items.title: India's Highest-Altitude High Court Bench Begins Regular Hearings in Leh

items.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio visited Reliance Industries' Jamnagar refinery complex in Gujarat on October 21, aiming to deepen energy cooperation between the United States and India. The visit highlighted Washington's interest in accessing Indian refining capacity and expanding US energy exports, coinciding with rising US LPG imports to India, which surged from under 10 per cent to 67 per cent of total imports in a year. While Reliance's Jamnagar complex processes about 1.4 million barrels of crude daily, analysts note that sourcing shifts depend on geopolitical factors and costs. The engagement also discussed Reliance's planned Texas refinery project and its broader clean-energy investments.
items.title: US Secretary Rubio visits Reliance Jamnagar refinery to boost India-US energy ties

items.summary: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd faces questions about its strategy as it defends its value proposition while pursuing growth. The retailer reported a 14% revenue rise to ₹3,398.5 crore, but net profit grew only 3.7% to ₹157.9 crore. Operating Ebitda margin narrowed to 7.7% from 8.5%. CEO Gunender Kapur attributed part of the moderation to a shift in the festive calendar, estimating growth would have been about 9% without the timing impact. The company is piloting Belong & Co., a premium apparel brand, and testing smaller-format stores. Shares fell as much as 8.2% on Wednesday.
items.title: Vishal Mega Mart Tests Premium Brand Amid Profit Pressure
